sloka: कच्चिद् वृद्धांश्च बालांश्च वैद्यमुख्यांश्च राघव ।दानेन मनसा वाचा त्रिभिरेतैर्बुभूषसे ॥ २.१००.६१॥
transliteration: kaccid vṛddhāṁśca bālāṁśca vaidyamukhyāṁśca rāghava ।dānena manasā vācā tribhiretairbubhūṣase ॥ 2.100.61॥

translations.english: I trust you pay homage to the preceptors, the aged ones, ascetics, gods and guests, to shrines and to accomplished brahmins.
